def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=max({x for row in grid for x in row},key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    # Find same-color diagonal connected runs and extend them until edges or another color.
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
       color=grid[r][c]
       if color==bg: continue
       for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        if (r,c,dr,dc) in seen: continue
        # identify run start
        pr,pc=r-dr,c-dc
        if 0<=pr<h and 0<=pc<w and grid[pr][pc]==color: continue
        cells=[]; rr,cc=r,c
        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==color:
         cells.append((rr,cc)); seen.add((rr,cc,dr,dc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
        if len(cells)<2: continue
        # extend at both ends through background, stop on colored blockers/boundaries
        for (er,ec,sr,sc) in ((cells[0][0]-dr,cells[0][1]-dc,-dr,-dc),(cells[-1][0]+dr,cells[-1][1]+dc,dr,dc)):
         rr,cc=er,ec
         while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==bg:
          out[rr][cc]=color; rr+=sr; cc+=sc
    return out

grid=[[5]*12 for _ in range(28)]; grid[25][8]=2; grid[26][7]=2; grid[26][6]=0; grid[27][6]=2; grid[27][7]=0
out=transform(grid)

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max(
        {value for row in grid for value in row},
        key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid),
    )

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or color == 0:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue

                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue

                for rr, cc, sr, sc in (
                    (run[0][0] - dr, run[0][1] - dc, -dr, -dc),
                    (run[-1][0] + dr, run[-1][1] + dc, dr, dc),
                ):
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
    return out
'''
